title: EmpUserProvisionProcessErr - Data API
description: Represents an employee-user provisioning process error. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: The ID of the Person Account linked to the employee record associated with the error. This is a relationship field.

EmployeeId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EmployeeId.description: The ID of the employee record associated with the error. This is a relationship field.

ErrorCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ErrorCode.description: The error code if the provisioning isn’t successful.

ErrorMessage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ErrorMessage.description: If an error occurred, this field contains the error message.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date and time when the error was last referenced, with a precision of one second.

LastViewedDate.description: The date and time when the error was last viewed, with a precision of one second.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

ProvisioningProcessId.description: The ID of the associated user provisioning process. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: This object requires a Workplace Command Center add-on license, or an Employee Experience add-on license.
usage: Use the EmpUserProvisionProcessErr to view the errors for an employee-user provisioning process.

Id.field_label: Employee User Provisioning Process Error ID
